cards.meaning: fugitive (from justice) — someone with a case and a warrant who evades arrest
cards.example: Idineklarang pugante ng Sandiganbayan ang tatlong kapwa-akusado ni Zaldy Co.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Sandiganbayan declared three of Zaldy Co's co-accused fugitives.
cards.note: Hiram sa Kastila (prófugo/pugante). Iba sa 'takas' (sinumang nakatakas, pati hayop) at 'nagtatago' (paglalarawan lang). May bigat ng batas: may kaso at pormal na deklarasyon ng korte — kaya maingat ang mamamahayag sa paggamit.
cards.tiesTo: Sandiganbayan declares Zaldy Co co-accused fugitives (flood-control case)

cards.example: Malabong maabot ng BIR ang 3.39 trilyong pisong target ngayong taon.
cards.exampleMeaning: The BIR is unlikely to hit its 3.39-trillion-peso target this year.
cards.note: Literal: hindi malinaw (malabong tubig, malabong mata). Sa balita: hindi malamang mangyari. Iba sa 'imposible' (sarado na); may kaunting puwang pa ang 'malabo'. Magalang na pagtanggi: 'Malabo akong makarating.'
cards.tiesTo: BIR full-year collection target in doubt

cards.meaning: for / as far as X is concerned (frames a point of view)
cards.example: 对于百度来说，AI云已经成了最重要的增长点。
cards.examplePinyin: Duìyú Bǎidù lái shuō, AI yún yǐjīng chéngle zuì zhòngyào de zēngzhǎng diǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: For Baidu, AI cloud has become its most important source of growth.
cards.note: 口语书面皆可,框定视角。对比 就……而言(更书面,多用于限定话题:就利润而言)。单用'对于'= regarding(对于这个问题)。
cards.tiesTo: Baidu Q3: ads -22% vs AI cloud +94%

cards.meaning: to face, be confronted with (a situation that has arrived)
cards.example: 很多中国科技公司面临新的出口限制。
cards.examplePinyin: Hěn duō Zhōngguó kējì gōngsī miànlín xīn de chūkǒu xiànzhì.
cards.exampleMeaning: Many Chinese tech companies face new export restrictions.
cards.note: 书面语。搭配:面临+压力/挑战/风险/危机/限制。近义:面对(主动应对:面对问题) vs 面临(处于某种处境,较被动);口语多用 遇到。
cards.tiesTo: US cloud-compute licence rule hits Baidu, Alibaba
